source_snapshot_identities.provenance_limitation: IVV is an official iShares issuer holdings snapshot for a fund that seeks to track the S&P 500. It is an explicit proxy, not official S&P 500 constituent data: holdings may include cash, derivatives, temporary positions, or issuer/share-class representation differences and may differ from the index roster.
